# DreamGUI

> DreamGUI is a UI plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8 whose screens are written as text: a .dui file under a project's DUI/ folder is the source of one widget Blueprint, a tree of widgets with their properties, layout, styles, bindings and animations.

`.dui` is not QML, XAML, UMG or CSS. Read the cheat sheet first, and look every node type and property up (DreamMCP's `lookup`, or the project's `DUI/.dui-symbols.json`) instead of guessing it: an unknown name is an error. A screen that compiles can still be laid out wrong; DreamMCP's `layout` reports what is off the screen, cut, too small, overlapping or out of its frame (DUI8xxx).

Every diagnostic carries a code `DUInnnn`. diagnostics.json lists each code with its name, severity, stage, meaning, fix where the documentation has one, and documentation link.

llms-full.txt holds the cheat sheet, the whole language, the worked example and the pitfalls page in one file.

## Start here

- [Cheat sheet](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/start/cheatsheet/): the language on one page; its complete files are compiled and laid out by the test suite
- [The full language reference](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/llms-full.txt): cheat sheet, language, worked example and pitfalls in one text file
- [Diagnostics as JSON](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/diagnostics.json): every DUInnnn: name, severity, stage, title, meaning, fix, doc

## Language

- [Overview](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/overview/): what a file holds
- [Nodes and values](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/nodes-and-values/): nodes, ids, tags, every kind of value, positions and axes
- [Slot lines and components](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/slots-and-components/): @slot lines and + components
- [Styles and resources](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/styles-and-resources/): styles and resources
- [use](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/use/): using other files and classes
- [Writing a component](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/components/): writing a component: props, events, slots
- [View models](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/viewmodels/): view models
- [Bindings and routes](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/bindings/): bindings and routes
- [if and for](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/control-flow/): if, for and each
- [rows tables](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/rows/): rows tables
- [Timelines](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/timelines/): animations
- [Worked example](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/dui/example/): a worked example
- [Common pitfalls](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/plugin/guides/pitfalls/): what compiles and still comes out wrong
- [The control library](https://gui.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/controls/): every Native.* control
